notes.title: Critical Bug Fixed in the Demo
notes.content:
Thank you for playing the demo!
We’ve released an important update that fixes a critical bug: a black screen that appeared when playing the record player and interrupted the game loop, preventing the demo from being completed.
Additionally:

Configuration interface issues have been fixed.

Some defects in Level of Detail (LODs) loading on furniture and walls in the living room have been resolved.

Keep exploring and share your feedback!
